evidence.title: GitHub - persianlabs/ui: A copy-paste component library, RTL-first for Persian interfaces. · GitHub

name: PersianLabs/ui
summary: RTL-first, shadcn-compatible registry of 75+ React components for Persian interfaces, from Bank Input to Jalali date pickers.
description: A copy-paste component registry for Persian (RTL) interfaces: logical properties and mirrored icons by default, with full LTR support, built on Base UI and Tailwind v4 and shipped as plain React source through a shadcn-compatible registry — no npm package to chase. Covers most of the shadcn/Base UI catalog plus Persian-specific pieces: Bank Input with card/Shaba validation, City Selector (province → city), Jalali Calendar/Date/Time pickers, Toman Icon, Receipt Printer, QR Code, Mobile Number Input, and validators for National ID, Postal Code and Persian dates.
contains: 75+ components, 10 utilities and 6 hooks across a shadcn-compatible registry (no npm package)
RTL-first: logical properties and mirrored icons by default, full LTR support
Persian pieces: Bank Input and bank utilities (card/Shaba validation), City Selector, Jalali pickers
extras: Toman Icon, Receipt Printer, QR Code, Mobile Number Input, Persian Reshape for OG images
validators and formatters: National ID, Postal Code, Persian Date, Persian Holidays, Persian Slug
covers most of the shadcn/Base UI catalog RTL-converted; Data Table is a docs guide for now
Turborepo monorepo with bun workspaces and a Next.js 16 docs site
